Recompute modulo 25:
\[
3203\equiv 3,\quad 4507\equiv 7,\quad 9929\equiv 4 \pmod{25}
\]
So
\[
3203\cdot 4507\cdot 9929 \equiv 3\cdot 7\cdot 4=84\equiv 9 \pmod{25}.
\]
Also product \(\equiv 1 \pmod 3\).

Find \(x\equiv 9\pmod{25}\) and \(x\equiv 1\pmod 3\):
\[
x=9+25k.
\]
Modulo 3:
\[
9+25k \equiv 0+k \equiv k \pmod 3.
\]
So \(k\equiv 1\pmod 3\). Let \(k=1\):
\[
x=9+25=34.
\]

\[
\boxed{34}
\]
